extraction.document_summary: GREAT Life Multiplier (Great Eastern) is a life insurance solution designed to provide protection while addressing both your own needs and your family’s. The brochure describes a base “Death Benefit under GREAT Life Multiplier”, and it is commonly enhanced with optional riders: (1) Critical Illness Multiplier Rider (E&I) for early/intermediate and critical stage critical illnesses, and (2) Parent Care Rider for guaranteed coverage for age-related conditions (e.g., Severe Dementia/Alzheimer’s Disease) “without medical assessment” at the point of coverage. A further feature mentioned is “Beneficiary access” (subject to nomination rules) for future decisions. The document also states that each “Special Benefit, Juvenile Benefit or Senior Benefit provides a payout equivalent to 25% of the rider sum assured” and that up to six claims can be made for different covered events. A key limitation explicitly stated is that pre-existing conditions are excluded.
quality_notes: The brochure text is incomplete/garbled in places, with many details (e.g., exact plan names, age ranges, premium terms, and specific benefit tables) not clearly shown.
Specific critical illness definitions, claim criteria, and the full list of covered conditions are not fully provided in the supplied text.
Numerous numeric items are only provided in customer illustrations, not as universally available plan limits.

policies.quick_summary:
A life insurance base plan with a Death Benefit, typically sold together with Critical Illness Multiplier Rider (E&I) and Parent Care Rider. The brochure also describes beneficiary access and special/juvenile/senior payouts of 25% of rider sum assured, with pre-existing conditions excluded and limited pay applying only to the base plan and critical illness rider(s). 
Evidence: “Claim for Death Benefit under GREAT Life Multiplier”. “Each Special Benefit, Juvenile Benefit or Senior Benefit provides a payout equivalent to 25% of the rider sum assured”. “Excluding pre-existing conditions.” “The limited pay option is applicable to the base plan and critical illness rider(s).”
coverage_scope: Critical illness benefits via Critical Illness Multiplier Rider (E&I) (optional riders)
Parent Benefit via Parent Care Rider (optional rider)
policies.eligibility_notes: All ages specified refer to age next birthday. Parent Care Rider provides guaranteed coverage for age-related conditions without medical assessment at point of coverage.
policies.premium_payment_term_description: Limited pay option is mentioned as applying to the base plan and critical illness rider(s), but full premium-payment structure is not clearly provided.
policies.bonuses_or_dividends: Non-guaranteed benefits are illustrated based on an Illustrated Investment Rate of Return (IIRR) of 4.25% p.a. at IIRR 3.00% p.a. non-guaranteed bonuses and Death Benefit payable are illustrated.
important_caveats: Limited pay option applies to the base plan and critical illness rider(s) but not to the Parent Care Rider.
Beneficiary access feature is subject to the policyholder not having made any nomination under the Beneficiary Access clause.
